content:
samir: Hey folks — PR #42177 is up: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/42177. It adjusts the eviction heuristic and adds a runtime fallback to a smaller quantized model when memory pressure spikes. Need cross-team signoff (runtime, platform, infra, security).

samir: TL;DR of changes:
- tighten idle eviction threshold
- on OOM/kvs pressure, route to model-v2-quantized (lower mem)
- add a short-circuit metric and audit log entry when fallback happens

samir: Important checks we need: latency regressions under 95th perc, correctness on a short eval set, KMS access pattern for model keys, and that audit logs capture user-ids for fallback events.

 taylor: @samir thanks. I'll run a quick perf sweep (50k tokens) and post numbers within the hour. :eyes:

 olivia: Can you paste the exact config knobs changed? quick scan would help.

 samir: Sure, snippet below:
```yaml
eviction:
  idle_ms: 45000  # was 60000
fallback:
  model: model-v2-quantized
  max_fallback_rate: 0.1
audit:
  fallback_event: true
```

 mike: From infra/security perspective: what KMS call pattern did you add? any new long-lived credentials?

 samir: No new creds. We added a single deterministic KMS decrypt per model load, same as before, but we now do it for the fallback model as well. Also emit `fallback_kms_call` metric.

 securitybot: FYI — automated scan flagged no high-risk dependencies. Manual review requested for audit trail completeness.

 taylor: Perf quick update: baseline p95=42ms, with this change p95=46ms under our synthetic load (10% fallbacks). I'll drop the full CSV in the PR.

 olivia: Looks reasonable. Two asks from platform side: (1) can we gate fallback to <5% for first 24h of rollout, and (2) add a route label so routing policy visibility shows fallback in console.

 samir: Will add rollout gate and route label. Also adding a canary flag `fallback.experimental=true` behind canary route.

 mike: Infra: can we get the KMS audit path? I want to confirm logs flow to the central ELK and retention. If retained 90 days we're good.

 samir: KMS audit path: "projects/redwood-prod/logs/kms-decrypt". I will add a JSON field `fallback_user_id` to the log entry.

 securitybot: Please include a sample log line in the PR comment for validation.

 samir: Added sample log in the PR comment. Also added a short eval suite of 100 prompts to make sure outputs don't degrade.

 taylor: Approving from runtime perf side pending canary rollout gating addition.

 olivia: Approving from platform if you add the route label and gate.

 mike: Infra ok as long as KMS audit lands in ELK and no extra service accounts.

 samir: Great — I'll push the gating change now. Can someone from security do a final eyes once I update the PR? @securitybot @securitybot :wave:

 securitybot: Noted — schedule me for manual review. ETA 4 hours.

 infra-bot: Merge window checker: next merge window opens 2024-06-18 09:00 UTC. If you want earlier, request an exception in #eng-sre.

 samir: Thanks all. I'll update PR and ping again when gating is in.

 taylor: thx, will re-run perf on the gated canary once it's up. :thumbsup:
